title: English as a Global Language
text:
English is spoken all over the world. Many people use it to talk to people from other countries. In business, science and travel, English is often the common language. Some people learn English because they want better jobs.

English is not only the language of England and the United States. People in India, Nigeria and the Philippines also speak English every day. Because of this, there are many different kinds of English. Most people do not mind this, because they can still understand each other.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do some people learn English?
options: They want to move to England
They want to read old books

questions.text: According to paragraph two, which countries are mentioned as places where people speak English every day?
What can we infer about English from the passage?
options: It is spoken only in England
It is used by many people in different countries
It is harder than all other languages
It is no longer used in business

questions.text: Why do most people not mind the different kinds of English?
options: Because they cannot hear the differences
Because they can still understand each other
Because they all speak with the same accent
Because the government tells them to

paragraph_translations: Angielski jest mówiony na całym świecie. Wiele osób używa go, aby rozmawiać z ludźmi z innych krajów. W biznesie, nauce i podróżach angielski jest często wspólnym językiem. Niektórzy ludzie uczą się angielskiego, ponieważ chcą mieć lepsze prace.

Angielski nie jest tylko językiem Anglii i Stanów Zjednoczonych. Ludzie w Indiach, Nigerii i na Filipinach także mówią po angielsku każdego dnia. Dlatego istnieje wiele różnych rodzajów angielskiego. Większość ludzi nie ma nic przeciwko temu, ponieważ wciąż mogą się nawzajem zrozumieć.
